name: @sei-js/create-sei
description: Scaffold new Sei applications with pre-configured templates and tooling

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --project ./tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/main.js && rsync -av --exclude-from=.rsyncignore ./templates/ ./dist/templates/ && rsync -av --exclude-from=.rsyncignore ./extensions/ ./dist/extensions/
